checks.detail: All 25 planned B007 expansion resource IDs are present exactly once across checkpoint resource tables. Precompleted pilot resources CR000174 and CR000184 were skipped and not duplicated.
All B007 JSONL records parse and contain required stable identifiers; evidence IDs are unique.
Three source URL corrections or repository transfers retain existing CR identities through VA000027, VA000028, and VA000029; no new stable ID was required.
All 14 Stage-1 paper-resource assertions belonging to B007 resources are represented as verified relationships; resources with no Stage-1 assertion received no invented PRL.
Twenty-three GitHub repositories are pinned to exact observed default-branch commits. The QDataLabs GitLab project and aqibrahimbt profile retain explicitly qualified snapshot states.
Direct paper association remains separate from PINN classification; non-PINN, supporting-library, profile, adjacent-physics-informed, and PINN implementation roles are preserved explicitly.

Thirteen positive repository-license findings, eleven checked absences, and one profile not-applicable state are represented separately; article licenses and open-source wording were not propagated to repository content.
Formal manifests, inline version evidence, bundled data, generated data, external datasets/models, and checked absences are distinguished without Stage-3 normalization or execution.
No paper-internal bibliography number was promoted to an Atlas ID.
The Stage-1 source snapshot and inventory remain unchanged; B007 changes are confined to the Stage-2 verification overlay and Stage-2 reports.
No unrepresentable schema conflict, relationship type, stable-ID change, or scientifically consequential ambiguity was found.
